description: This file declares functions, structures, and enums related to commit reachability and merge base calculations in a version control system, likely Git.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases
methods.description: Finds common ancestors (merge bases) between two commits in a repository.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Finds merge bases among multiple commits.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many_dirty
methods.description: Finds merge bases among multiple commits, ignoring object flags after call.

methods.name: get_octopus_merge_bases
methods.description: Calculates merge bases for an octopus merge scenario.

methods.name: repo_is_descendant_of
methods.description: Checks if a commit is a descendant of another.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge bases of a repository.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge bases of multiple references.

methods.name: reduce_heads
methods.description: Reduces a list of commits by removing reachable commits.

methods.name: reduce_heads_replace
methods.description: Replaces a list of commits with its reduced form to avoid memory leaks.

methods.name: ref_newer
methods.description: Determines if one object ID is newer than another.

methods.name: commit_contains
methods.description: Checks if a commit contains another commit based on a filter and cache.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach_with_flag
methods.description: Checks if all commits in 'from' can reach commits marked with 'with_flag'.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach
methods.description: Checks reachability between commit lists with a date cutoff.

methods.name: get_reachable_subset
methods.description: Returns commits reachable from 'from' list and adds a flag.

methods.name: tips_reachable_from_bases
methods.description: Marks tip commits reachable from given base commits.

methods.name: get_branch_base_for_tip
methods.description: Finds the branch base for a given tip among multiple bases.
